The '''Bajic system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]] connected the system to the [[Vohai system/Legends|Vohai]] and [[Lybeya system/Legends|Vergesso systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Bajic system became a flashpoint of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Multiple battles were fought within the system, with both the Empire and the Alliance emerging victorious at different [[Time/Legends|times]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bajic system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square P-18.<ref name="TEA" />
